name: branding-lime-and-black-ui-cards-tote-and-stickers-board
title: Floating black UI cards on lime, a black tote with lime arc and round stickers
whatItIs: A board with a lime-to-olive blurred field of tilted black notification cards (rewards, ETA, pricing, payment), beneath which a black tote with a huge lime arc and white wordmark hangs on a chair, and lime, white and black round stickers with the logo and slogan.
whatItMeans: Energetic and cohesive; one lime-black system runs from UI to merch.
techniques: Float UI cards in 3D perspective as a pattern.
Reuse the logo arc as a graphic on merch.
Make round stickers in three colourways.

vocabulary.definition: A cropped part of the logo used as graphic.
A sticker cut to a round shape.
Products shown in a lifestyle scene.
